name: Fader blend over 32 bars
lesson:
## The trance-length blend

B enters with its low EQ off and its fader rising across the full 32 bars to bar 33. There the bass swaps over two bars and A leaves across bars 35 to 49. A minute of two tracks playing together, which is why trance and progressive DJs are strict about key.

At 138 BPM, 32 bars is 56 seconds of fader travel. Nobody moves a fader that slowly by hand in one motion; you move it a few millimetres every 4 bars, on the bar line, and the ramp scores the sum. Keep the low cut on B until the swap; the swap is where the mix becomes B's.
